title: Officials deny such a craft in inventory; Rogers says he saw it

tellings.quote: uh, some of the government officials said, "We have never had a craft like that in our inventory." And I was sitting there saying, "What are you talking about?" I saw it.

plain: When government officials said in recent years that the US had "never had a craft like that in our inventory," one man says he knew otherwise because he had seen it. He is Greg Rogers, a doctor who worked with NASA, and he tells Michels he saw such a craft in a secret hangar. He recalls sitting and listening to the denial thinking, "What are you talking about? I saw it," which would mean officials were denying something real.
